import collections,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import read,sha,now

base=root/"artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020"
complete=read(run/"completion.json")
assert complete["status"]=="completed_bounded_mechanism_study" and len(complete["batch_summary"])==8
assert not (run/"failure.json").exists()
physical={};by_batch=collections.defaultdict(set);by_stage=collections.defaultdict(set)
for stage in (run/"native").iterdir():
 if not stage.is_dir() or not re.match(r"^b[1-8]_",stage.name):continue
 for p in stage.glob("*.json"):
  if p.name.endswith((".input.json",".answer.json")):continue
  raw=read(p)
  if "calls" not in raw or raw.get("response") is None:continue
  name=str(p.relative_to(root));physical[name]=raw
  by_batch[int(stage.name.split("_",1)[0][1:])].add(name);by_stage[stage.name].add(name)
def cost(names):
 names=set(names);xs=[physical[n] for n in names]
 for n,x in zip(names,xs):
  assert len(x["calls"])==1 and x["transport_error"] is None
  wire=x["calls"][0]["response"];r=x["response"]
  assert wire["usage"]["prompt_tokens"]==r["prompt_tokens"] and wire["usage"]["completion_tokens"]==r["completion_tokens"]
  assert wire["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]==r["content"] and wire["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]==r["finish_reason"]
 return {"original_generations":len(xs),"generation_HTTP":sum(len(x["calls"]) for x in xs),
  "input_tokens":sum(x["response"]["prompt_tokens"] for x in xs),"output_tokens":sum(x["response"]["completion_tokens"] for x in xs),
  "finish_reasons":dict(collections.Counter(x["response"]["finish_reason"] for x in xs))}
core=set();own=set();first=set();TRAIN=set();logical_own_B1_after_B1=0;evidence=set(physical)
for b in range(1,9):
 fp=run/f"batches/b{b}_prequential_records.json";pp=run/f"publications/b{b}.json"
 f,pub=read(fp),read(pp);evidence.update([str(fp.relative_to(root)),str(pp.relative_to(root))])
 for arm in ("empty","skills"):
  assert len(f[arm])==32
  first.update(r["raw_call_path"] for r in f[arm])
 own.update(r["raw_call_path"] for r in f.get("frozen_after_B1",[]))
 if b>=2:logical_own_B1_after_B1+=len(f["frozen_after_B1"])
 for decision in pub["training_decisions"]:
  for kind in ("proposed_replay","actual_replay"):
   TRAIN.update(r["raw_call_path"] for r in decision.get(kind,[]))
core=first|TRAIN;only=own-core
assert first<=set(physical) and TRAIN<=set(physical) and own<=set(physical)
assert core|only==set(physical) and not core&only
assert logical_own_B1_after_B1==224
allcost,corecost,onlycost=cost(physical),cost(core),cost(only)
assert allcost["original_generations"]==complete["actual_native_calls"]==1158
assert allcost["input_tokens"]==complete["native_prompt_tokens"]==7655443
assert allcost["output_tokens"]==complete["native_completion_tokens"]==3232344
teachers={str(p.relative_to(root)):read(p) for p in (run/"teacher").glob("b*/response.json") if re.match(r"^b[1-8]_",p.parent.name)}
assert len(teachers)==complete["actual_teacher_responses"]==15
def teacher_cost(names):
 xs=[teachers[n] for n in names]
 assert all(x["cache_hit"] is False and x["model"]=="gpt-5.6-sol" and x["invocation"]["returncode"]==0 for x in xs)
 return {"fresh_responses":len(xs),"transport_attempts":sum(x["capacity_transport_attempt_index"]+1 for x in xs),
  "input_tokens":sum(x["invocation"]["usage"]["input_tokens"] for x in xs),
  "output_tokens":sum(x["invocation"]["usage"]["output_tokens"] for x in xs),
  "reasoning_included_in_output":sum(x["invocation"]["usage"].get("reasoning_output_tokens",0) for x in xs),
  "response_elapsed_seconds_not_GPU_hours":sum(x["invocation"]["elapsed_seconds"] for x in xs)}
tc=teacher_cost(teachers);assert tc["input_tokens"]==3232522 and tc["output_tokens"]==51361
evidence.update(teachers);evidence.add(str((run/"completion.json").relative_to(root)))
batches=[]
for b,names in sorted(by_batch.items()):
 tn={n for n in teachers if re.match(rf"^b{b}_",Path(n).parent.name)}
 row={"batch":b,"total_actual_native":cost(names),"core_referenced_native_first_created_here":cost(names&core),
  "only_own_B1_evaluation_native_first_created_here":cost(names&only),"actual_teachers":teacher_cost(tn)}
 batches.append(row)
stages={stage:cost(names) for stage,names in sorted(by_stage.items())}
for key in ("original_generations","generation_HTTP","input_tokens","output_tokens"):
 assert corecost[key]+onlycost[key]==allcost[key]
 assert sum(b["total_actual_native"][key] for b in batches)==allcost[key]
